title: AI Frameworks — reference knowledge
description: Portable, reusable reference knowledge for the AI framework ecosystem: one record per framework, library or tool, goal-oriented use cases (the building blocks a system needs, each with a default choice, alternatives and how to choose) and per-category landscapes (the defacto choice, who is rising, key concepts, and canonical reading).
